# Subprocessor lists for the eight vendors (pages read 2026-10-17)

All eight lists are public: none needs a login and none is a PDF. Every URL below was fetched live. Counts come from counting rows on each page and then removing duplicate names; where a page has several tables, both numbers are given. "Outside the US/EU" uses the location written on the page. The UK, Switzerland and EEA countries outside the EU are shown separately as borderline cases.

## Summary

| Vendor | Exact page | Count | Last updated (as shown) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linear | https://trust.linear.app/subprocessors (Vanta trust center); a copy is in Exhibit B of https://linear.app/dpa | 34 (the page says "1-10 of 34 results") | **No date on the page.** The latest subprocessor change in the log at https://trust.linear.app/updates is dated "Published September 23, 2026". |
| Notion | https://notion.notion.site/Notion-s-List-of-Subprocessors-268fa5bcfa0f46b6bc29436b21676734 | 40 rows: 29 distinct third parties + 7 Notion entities | "Last updated: September 21, 2026" |
| Figma | https://www.figma.com/sub-processors | 52 third-party rows (43 distinct companies) + 15 Figma entities | "Last Updated: September 22, 2026" |
| Vercel | https://security.vercel.com/?itemName=legal&itemUid=e3fae2ca-94a9-416b-b577-5c90e382df57 (`vercel.com/legal/sub-processors` redirects here) | 28 | "Last updated 8/21/26" |
| Intercom | https://www.intercom.com/legal/subprocessors-list | 18 distinct (14 third parties + 4 affiliates), spread over 43 rows in US, EU, Australia and affiliate lists | "Effective June 25, 2026" |
| Retool | https://docs.retool.com/legal/subprocessors | 13 rows (11 distinct third parties) + 1 affiliate named in the text | "Last updated on Jul 29, 2026" |
| Airtable | https://www.airtable.com/company/subprocessors | 27 rows (26 distinct, because AWS appears twice); 24 of the rows are third parties and 3 are affiliates | "Last Updated: August 25, 2026" |
| Loom | https://www.atlassian.com/legal/sub-processors (Loom's legal pages redirect to Atlassian) | 11 rows that name Loom (10 distinct companies) + 15 Atlassian group entities | "Effective Starting May 15, 2026" |

## Subprocessors outside the US/EU, by vendor

**Linear** (https://trust.linear.app/subprocessors)
- No subprocessor is in a named non-US/EU country.
- Cloudflare is listed as **"Global"**.
- The other entries are "United States" or "United States, European Union".
- The page and the DPA disagree on Anthropic: "United States" on the trust center, "United States, European Union" in the DPA.
- Linear says it is moving the list from the DPA to the trust center (https://trust.linear.app/updates, May 13, 2026).

**Notion** (notion.site link above, reached from https://www.notion.com/help/gdpr-at-notion)
- **Third parties outside the US/EU:**
  - Korea and Japan: AWS, Confluent, Turbopuffer, StarTree, Fivetran
  - Japan: PlanetScale
  - Singapore: Mathpix
- **Notion's own entities outside the US/EU:**
  - India: Brain Capital Labs
  - Japan: Notion Labs Japan
  - Australia: Notion Labs Australia
  - South Korea: Notion Labs Korea
- **UK (borderline):** X.AI LLC ("USA, UK") and Notion Labs United Kingdom.
- **"Global":** Anthropic, Cloudflare, Fireworks, OpenAI, Google LLC, Baseten, Modal.
- **Conflicting version:** Notion's trust center at https://trust.notion.com/subprocessors shows an older, undated list. It includes Amplitude, leaves out five vendors, and gives different locations for some, such as X.AI as US and Belgium. I used the dated notion.site page.

**Figma** (https://www.figma.com/sub-processors)
- **Third parties outside the US/EU:**
  - BytePlus Sdn. Bhd.: Indonesia, Malaysia
  - Enhancor: Indonesia, Malaysia
  - Kling AI Pte. Ltd.: Singapore
  - Lightricks: Israel, plus the UK (borderline)
  - IntouchCX: Canada, the Philippines
- **Figma's own entities outside the US/EU:** Australia, Brazil, Canada, India, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, New Zealand (Figma International LLC) and Israel (Weavy AI Ltd).
- **UK (borderline):** Figma UK Limited.
- **Vague location:** Figma, Inc. is listed only as "EEA, United States", with no country named.
- **Possible routing elsewhere:** AWS hosting can be "the hosting location selected" for Enterprise plans. All 9 AI model providers carry a footnote that requests "may be routed through global data centers".

**Vercel** (security.vercel.com link above)
- **UK (borderline):** Plain.
- Tinybird is in Spain (EU). The other 26 are all "United States".

**Intercom** (https://www.intercom.com/legal/subprocessors-list)
- **Australia hosting region:** AWS, Snowflake, Cloudflare, PlanetScale and Ably are listed in Australia. AI processing on AWS Bedrock still happens in the USA.
- **Affiliate in Australia:** Intercom Software Australia Pty Ltd.
- **UK (borderline):** Intercom Software UK Limited, an affiliate.
- **Email processed "globally":** Mailgun and Sparkpost in the EU list, and Sparkpost in the Australia list.
- **No country given:** the EU Sparkpost entry.
- An earlier version of the list is at https://www.intercom.com/legal/subprocessors-list/old.

**Retool** (https://docs.retool.com/legal/subprocessors)
- All 13 third-party rows are "United States".
- **UK (borderline):** the affiliate Retool UK Limited. It is named in the text only, with no location stated.

**Airtable** (https://www.airtable.com/company/subprocessors)
- **Third parties outside the US/EU:**
  - PartnerHero: Honduras, the Philippines (alongside USA, Germany, Romania)
  - AWS: Australia, only for customers using Australian data residency
- **Affiliates outside the US/EU:** Formagrid Australia (Australia) and Formagrid Canada (Canada).
- **UK (borderline):** Formagrid UK Ltd.
- **"Global":** AWS and Google LLC in the AI table.

**Loom** (https://www.atlassian.com/legal/sub-processors)
- Loom has no separate list. It shares Atlassian's page, and I counted only rows whose "Applicable Cloud Products" column lists Loom or Loom AI. Several rows, including Cloudflare and the Bedrock/Vertex generative-AI rows, leave Loom out.
- The redirect from loom.com was confirmed: https://www.loom.com/dpa returns a 302 to https://www.atlassian.com/legal/data-processing-addendum, and §4.2 there links to the subprocessor page.
- **Third parties outside the US/EU:**
  - AWS hosting: Canada, Australia, Singapore, South Korea, India, Japan; Switzerland and UK (borderline)
  - PartnerHero: the Philippines, South Africa (alongside Romania, EU)
  - AWS Bedrock (support row only; locations come from its main row): South Africa, Japan, South Korea, India, Singapore, Australia, Indonesia, Canada, Bahrain, Mexico, Brazil; Switzerland and UK (borderline)
  - Google Vertex AI (support row only; locations come from its main row): Singapore, Taiwan
- **Atlassian group entities outside the US/EU:** Canada, India, Japan, Korea, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Australia and Türkiye; the UK is borderline.
- **Count for the 5-entity Government Cloud table:** I left it out because it doesn't mention Loom.
- **Older versions:** https://www.atlassian.com/legal/archives/archived-sub-processors.

## Caveats
1. **Counts depend on what you count.** Several vendors list the same company more than once (AWS, Google, OpenAI, Twilio and others) or list their own affiliates separately. The table gives rows and distinct companies so the numbers can be checked.
2. **Linear shows no date for the list.** The September 23, 2026 date is from its change log, not from the list page. The only other date is "Signed: May 31, 2025" on the DPA, and that does not track the list: the list in it includes subprocessors added in August–September 2026.
3. **Notion and Linear each have two versions that disagree.** I used the dated or primary version and noted the differences above.
4. **Locations are as the vendors wrote them.** Some company names suggest a different home country, for example Bright Data Ltd. (Airtable) and Bria AI Ltd (Figma) are both listed as USA. I did not override what the page says.
5. **Lists change.** Everything here reflects the pages as fetched on 2026-10-17.
